name: adsb-aircraft
description: Decode the ADS-B messages of aircraft at 1090 MHz from a 2 MS/s unsigned 8-bit baseband (RTL-SDR): identification, position and velocity as one JSON text packet per message.

rf.description: IQ at exactly 2 MS/s tuned to 1090 MHz

messages.description: One packet per decoded message: the JSON text (time, hex, icao, df, tc, flight, category, alt_baro, lat, lon, gs, track, baro_rate or geom_rate), indexed like the frame it came from
